0022600157.text: The Toronto Raptors (3-2, 3rd in the Atlantic and 4th in the East, 1.5 games back in the division) visit the Los Angeles Lakers (4-2, 1st in the Pacific and 5th in the West), with Toronto 1-1 on the road and both teams coming off a loss. Toronto will be without Kawhi Leonard (out, knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (out, foot fracture), while the Lakers will be without Adou Thiero (out, knee inflammation) and have Ziaire Williams listed as day-to-day with a foot injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Raptors lost both games 0-2, most recently 110-93 in Los Angeles on January 18, 2026.
